title: blockDiagram
body:
## blockDiagram

Draws a small technical block diagram from boxes you place yourself (x, y, width, height in millimetres) and left-to-right arrows between them. Inkscape writes an editable diagram.svg, exports diagram.png and the measured geometry is saved as diagram-measurements.json; the run succeeds only if the real text and shapes fit as declared. Choose it when you need control over positions; use flowDiagram to have positions derived from step dependencies.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Every arrow must run left to right with at least max(clearance, 3) mm between the boxes, and must not pass through another box.
- Text that fits on paper may still overflow in the installed font (LABEL_OVERFLOW); enlarge the box, shorten the label or reduce fontSize.
- The PNG is flattened; keep diagram.svg for editing. No custom SVG, styles or scripts can be supplied.

Native binding: `Inkscape SVG/query/export`. Output kind: `["image","text"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | Page width in millimetres, 20 to 500. All boxes, including their 0.4 mm outline, must lie at least margin from the page edges. The exported PNG is width x dpi / 25.4 pixels wide (at most 4096). | `{"type":"number","minimum":20,"maximum":500}` | **required** |
| `height` | Page height in millimetres, 20 to 500. All boxes, including their 0.4 mm outline, must lie at least margin from the page edges. The exported PNG is height x dpi / 25.4 pixels high (at most 4096). | `{"type":"number","minimum":20,"maximum":500}` | **required** |
| `margin` | Minimum mm clearance from page edges to stroked rectangles; default 5 mm. | `{"type":"number","minimum":1,"maximum":50}` | `5` |
| `clearance` | Minimum Euclidean mm separation between rectangle strokes, default 5 mm; left-to-right connectors also require at least 3 mm for arrows. | `{"type":"number","minimum":1,"maximum":50}` | `5` |
| `padding` | Minimum mm inset for all actual native label glyph bounds; default 2 mm. Native font-dependent overflow is a distinct execution fault. | `{"type":"number","minimum":1,"maximum":20}` | `2` |
| `fontSize` | Sans-serif text font size in mm; default 3 mm. Lower this or enlarge the box if native queried text bounds overflow. | `{"type":"number","minimum":1,"maximum":10}` | `3` |
| `dpi` | Native PNG export pixels per inch, 72–192, default 96; page pixels are nearest-integer mm*dpi/25.4 with a 4096 limit per axis. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":72,"maximum":192}` | `96` |
| `boxes` | The labelled boxes, 1 to 32. For blockDiagram each box also gives x, y, width and height in millimetres; for flowDiagram only id, label and colour are given and geometry is derived. | `{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":32,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":80,"required":true},"x":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1000,"required":true},"y":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1000,"required":true},"width":{"type":"number","minimum":5,"maximum":1000,"required":true},"height":{"type":"number","minimum":5,"maximum":1000,"required":true},"colour":{"type":"enum","values":["blue","green","amber"],"default":"blue"}}}}` | **required** |
| `links` | Up to 48 arrows between declared boxes. In blockDiagram the source box must be to the left of its target; in flowDiagram links are dependencies that decide the column layout and must not form a cycle. | `{"type":"array","maxItems":48,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"source":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"target":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true}}}}` | `[]` |
